study type: Comparative, blinded, prospective, randomized, and efficiency study
exposure: Quadratus lumborum block type (QLB-II vs. QLB-III)
cohort: 80 patients undergoing elective cesarean delivery (CD) under spinal anesthesia
finding: QLB-III block provided superior analgesic efficacy compared to QLB-II block in patients undergoing CD under spinal anesthesia, demonstrated by lower opioid consumption and pain scores in the QLB-III group.
